Voice assistant

DictaDay

Clear your head at night. Find your plan in the morning.

Who is it for?

Busy people and freelancers who prefer to dictate tasks.

The problem to solve

Ideas and tasks pile up at inconvenient moments, with no simple place to capture them.

What the project offers

  • 01Voice-note capture on Telegram
  • 02Task transcription and categorization
  • 03Morning recap and action plan
  • 04Tracking confirmed, postponed or archived tasks

The story behind it

I wanted to clear my head at night without opening a task manager. That became “Voice, Sleep, Planned”.

Available to test

Where does it stand?

Updated: 1 November 2026

Functional multi-user V1. The experience is still being improved, including dictation and automation workflows.
